blocks.text: Pages are those the project's own search returns for "Uganda", so some only mention it. Views are from July 2015; sizes are the current size of each page.

items.b: 202 pages on Wikibooks mention Uganda, written from 2001 onward and read 8,003,303 times since July 2015. The median page has been read 4,822 times.
“Introduction to Sociology/Print version” alone holds 33.9% of all views, and the ten most read pages hold 78%. Readership is highly concentrated, so a few pages decide the story.
Views peaked in 2019 at 1,995,778. The last full year, 2025, drew 626,258, 69% below the peak. So far in 2026: 459,558 views.
Most pages were written in 2010 (20). In the last five calendar years (2022–2026, the last one part-way) 28 pages were written, against 38 in the five years before that — the pace is slowing.
1,949 registered accounts have edited these pages in all. Editors peaked in 2009 (391); in 2025 there were 38.
10% of pages are stubs (under 1,000 bytes) and 37% are long (20,000 bytes and over).
“No Wikidata item” affects 170 pages (84%). Suggested action: Connect to Wikidata.
16% of pages are linked to a Wikidata item, and 15% have no Luganda article for the subject — 31 candidates for translation.
21% of pages were edited in the last year; 77 (38%) have not been touched for five years or more.

blocks.text: Pages written, edits and editors come from each page's own edit history, so they reach back to the first page. Views are recorded only from July 2015. Editors are registered accounts, counted once a year.
